notes: Paths are the engine's model of each mission, not the flown trajectories: real missions made trajectory-correction and phasing burns that are not modelled.

Lunar orbit: circular, plane drifting with the J2 node regression (the landing analysis's model); the phase along the orbit is adjusted so the spacecraft reaches the site at the landing time (the analysis does not model phasing).
Descent: schematic (deorbit half-ellipse to 15 km, braking arc); its delta-v is the analysis's, its path and timing are illustrative.
